Paths are relative to the repository root.

```{r}
set.seed(123)
```

Load input
```{r}
counts = read.delim("data/Gide_log2TPM.txt", row.names = 1)

# Deconvolution of Gide from Scenario 1: raw features (deconv_Gide) and subgroups (dt)
load("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario1/Results/deconvolution_results.RData")
```

Transform to TPM
```{r}
counts_TPM = 2^as.matrix(counts) - 1
```

Deconvolution

The deconvolution is not computed again: the features and subgroups of Scenario 1 are resued.
```{r}
library(RaCInG)

is_group = function(x) grepl("^(Immune|Stroma)_|_(Immune|Stroma)$", x)

deconv = dt[["Deconvolution matrix"]]
dt_cells = dt
dt_cells[["Deconvolution matrix"]] = deconv[, !is_group(colnames(deconv))]
dt_cells[["Deconvolution subgroups composition"]] = lapply(dt[["Deconvolution subgroups composition"]], function(x) x[!is_group(names(x))])

deconv_cells = dt_cells[["Deconvolution matrix"]]
dim(deconv_cells)
```

RaCInG

Expression profile of each cell type: estimated per method and signature from the raw features, then merged according to the subgroups.
```{r}
dir.create("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario4/Results", showWarnings = FALSE)

cell_expr_profile = RaCInG:::.estimate_expression_profiles_subgroups(counts_TPM, deconv_Gide, dt_cells)

input <- prepare_input_files(
  counts = counts_TPM,
  deconv = deconv_cells,
  cell_expr_profile = cell_expr_profile,
  already_normalized = TRUE,
  output_folder = "evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario4/Results/",
  file_name = "Gide"
)

length(input$celltypes)
```

Kernel method: direct interactions (D)
```{r}
kernel_res <- compute_racing_kernel(
  input_data = input,
  file_name = "Gide",
  output_folder = "evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario4/Results/",
  communication_type = "D"
)

direct = as.matrix(kernel_res$features)
dim(direct)
```

Save results
```{r}
save(input, direct, file = "evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario4/Results/RaCInG_results.RData")
```

Most common direct interactions

Share of each direct interaction in the communication of each patient, then the median over patients.
```{r}
direct_share = direct / rowSums(direct)

head(sort(apply(direct_share, 2, median), decreasing = TRUE), 10)
```

Summary figure

The ten most common direct interactions (median share of the communication of a patient).
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

load("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario4/Results/RaCInG_results.RData")  # input, direct

# A column "Dir_<A>_<B>" as "A - B" (cell-type names contain "_")
pair_name = function(column, celltypes) {
  name = sub("^Dir_", "", column)
  for (a in celltypes) {
    b = substring(name, nchar(a) + 2)
    if (startsWith(name, paste0(a, "_")) && b %in% celltypes) return(paste(a, b, sep = " - "))
  }
  name
}

share = direct / rowSums(direct)
top = sort(apply(share, 2, median), decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
top = data.frame(interaction = sapply(names(top), pair_name, celltypes = input$celltypes), share = 100 * top)
top$interaction = factor(top$interaction, levels = rev(top$interaction))

ggplot(top, aes(share, interaction)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2a78d6", width = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  labs(x = "Median share of the patient's communication (%)", y = NULL, title = "Top 10 direct cell-cell interactions")

ggsave("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario4/Results/top_interactions.pdf", width = 7, height = 3.5)
ggsave("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario4/Results/top_interactions.png", width = 7, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)
```
